The following events took place in '''9 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
[[File:Moldy_crow.jpg|thumb|250px|The ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' was manufactured.]]
*The [[Cirra Mace]] was stolen by an irate [[Seelas|Seela]], a heretic-outcast of the [[Aramandi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Seela [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] was caught before escaping the [[Aramand Cluster]], but not before the mace was sold to an unknown third party. The Cirra Mace disappeared for [[6 ABY/Legends|fifteen]] [[Time/Legends|years]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
*[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] entered the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].
*The [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] stopped exclusively using [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] and allowed non-clone recruits.<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>
*A [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] crumbled the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] civilization, converting those that survived into [[Realspace/Legends|spacefaring]] nomads.
*The [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] that would become ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' was manufactured.
*[[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] purchased the patents and production rights to the [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]] and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighter]] from [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]].
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] contracted a case of [[dust fever]].<ref name="Sandstorm">{{Tales|15|Sandstorm (comic story)}}</ref>
